content.comment_body: I've filled up the available space in the diagram editor (FBD), and it appears that the editor has a fixed workspace. How can I review the percentage of [product_name] memory used by my logic? If memory remains, is there a way to expand the diagram editor area to add more logic? Appreciate any help!

The memory capacity in [product_name] is determined by the total number of logic blocks you use. For example, with [article_no], you can utilize up to 400 blocks. If you need additional space for blocks in the diagram editor, you can increase the number of sheets in the diagram, both horizontally and vertically.

analysis.insight_summary: The user faces limits with the diagram editor's workspace in the FBD Editor of [product_name], wishing to visually increase the working area. The challenge centers on a restricted design space, leading to questions about checking memory usage and expanding the workspace. Responses clarify that memory is based on block count rather than workspace size, and that the diagram can be made larger by adjusting the sheet settings.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to monitor memory usage based on their logic setup and to conveniently enlarge the FBD editing area, provided memory capacity allows.
